q1.explanationZh: drain 名词“排水沟；消耗”，动词“（使）慢慢流掉；耗尽”。

q2.explanationZh: drama“戏剧；剧本”，形容词是 dramatic。

q3.explanationZh: drama 去掉 a 加 -atic 构成形容词 dramatic“戏剧性的”。

q4.explanationZh: draw 意思很多：“拉；吸引；画”，过去式 drew，过去分词 drawn。

q5.explanationZh: draw“拉”加 -er，drawer 是“拉出来的东西”——抽屉。

q6.explanationZh: draw“画”加 -ing 构成名词 drawing“图画”。

q7.explanationZh: dream 名词“梦；理想”，动词“做梦；梦想”，dream of doing sth.“梦想做某事”。

q8.explanationZh: dress 名词“连衣裙；衣服”，动词“给……穿衣”，注意结尾双写 s。

q9.explanationZh: drift 动词、名词同形，“漂流”。

q10.explanationZh: drill 名词“钻头；训练”，动词“钻孔；操练”，结尾双写 l。

q11.explanationZh: drink 动词“喝”，名词“饮料”，过去式 drank，过去分词 drunk。

q12.explanationZh: drip“滴下”，现在分词双写 p：dripping。

q13.explanationZh: drive 动词“驾驶；驱使”，名词“车程；干劲”，过去式 drove，过去分词 driven。

q14.explanationZh: drive 加 -r 表示人，driver“驾驶员”。

q16.explanationZh: drop 名词“滴”，动词“落下；下降”，过去式双写 p：dropped。

q17.explanationZh: drought“干旱”，注意 -ought 的拼写，与 dry 意思相关。

q18.explanationZh: drown“淹死”，过去式 drowned（不要写成 drownd）。

q19.explanationZh: drug 名词“药物；毒品”，动词“用药麻醉”，过去式 drugged。

q20.explanationZh: drug“药”+ store“商店”，合成 drugstore“药店”。

q22.explanationZh: dry 形容词“干的”，也可作动词“使干；变干”，过去式 dried。

q24.explanationZh: due 形容词“到期的；应得的”，be due for“应该得到”。

q25.explanationZh: due to“由于；因为”，后接名词或代词。

q26.explanationZh: dull“乏味的；愚钝的”，结尾双写 l。

q27.explanationZh: due 去掉 e 加 -ly 构成副词 duly“适当地；按时地”（不是 duely）。

q28.explanationZh: dump 动词“倾倒；倾销”，名词“垃圾堆”。

q29.explanationZh: dumpling“饺子；汤团”，注意 -mp- 的拼写。

q30.explanationZh: duration“持续时间”，-ation 是名词后缀。

q31.explanationZh: during 介词“在……期间”，后接表示一段时间的名词。

q33.explanationZh: dust 名词“灰尘”，动词“擦去灰尘”。

q34.explanationZh: dust“灰尘”+ bin“箱子”，合成 dustbin“垃圾箱”。

q35.explanationZh: dust 加 -y 构成形容词 dusty“满是灰尘的”。

q36.explanationZh: duty“责任；义务”，be on duty“值日；上班”。

q37.explanationZh: “对……巨大的消耗”= a great drain on sth.，drain 作名词“消耗”，介词用 on。

q38.explanationZh: “人才外流”= brain drain，brain“头脑”指人才。

q39.explanationZh: “得出结论”可以说 draw / form / reach / make a conclusion。

q40.explanationZh: “吸引某人的注意”= draw / attract one’s attention，draw 有“吸引”的意思。

q41.explanationZh: “梦想做某事”= dream of doing sth.，of 是介词，后接动名词。

q42.explanationZh: “梦见某人或某事”= dream of / about sb. / sth.，介词 of 或 about 都可以。

q43.explanationZh: “由于；因为”= due to，to 是介词，后接名词。

q44.explanationZh: 表示“穿上”这个动作用 dress oneself in，dress 后接反身代词。

q45.explanationZh: 表示“穿着”的状态用 be dressed in，用被动形式。

q46.explanationZh: drift 作名词“漂流；流动”，the drift of the tide“潮汐的冲流”。

accept: build up a habit by drill

q47.explanationZh: drill 作名词“训练”，by drill“通过训练”，build up a habit“养成习惯”。

q48.explanationZh: “逼迫某人做某事”= drive sb. to do sth.，to 后接动词原形。

q49.explanationZh: “把某人逼疯”= drive sb. mad，drive 后接宾语和形容词 mad 作补足语。

q50.explanationZh: “顺便拜访”= drop in，拜访某人用 drop in on sb.，拜访某地用 drop in at sp.。

q51.explanationZh: “值日；上班”= be on duty，介词用 on；“下班”是 be off duty。

q52.explanationZh: “一种水禽”指鸭子 duck，位于句首首字母大写。

q53.explanationZh: keep sb. + 形容词“使某人保持……”，“不被淋湿”用 dry。

q54.explanationZh: be dressed in“穿着……”表示状态，was 后用过去分词 dressed。

q55.explanationZh: draw a conclusion from“从……得出结论”，can 后用动词原形 draw。

q56.explanationZh: drop“下降”，drop to freezing“降到冰点”，can 后用原形。

q57.explanationZh: 掉进河里会“淹死”drown，与 fall 并列用原形。

q58.explanationZh: “治头痛的药”= a drug for headache，a kind of 后接单数名词。

q59.explanationZh: 动名词 drinking 作主语，“喝太多果汁”，位于句首首字母大写。

q60.explanationZh: a great drain on sth.“对……巨大的消耗”，drain 作名词。

q61.explanationZh: dream of doing sth.“梦想做某事”，主语 he 是第三人称单数，用 dreams。

q62.sampleAnswer: The teacher is drilling the students in pronunciation.
references: The teacher is drilling the students in pronunciation.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “正在训练”用现在进行时 is drilling；drill sb. in sth.“在某方面训练某人”。

q63.sampleAnswer: Many people object to building a nuclear power plant on the island for fear that the wastewater might be dumped into the sea and pollute the marine life.
references: Many people object to building a nuclear power plant on the island for fear that the wastewater might be dumped into the sea and pollute the marine life.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: object to doing sth.“反对做某事”，to 是介词；for fear that“担心……”；废水“被排入”大海用被动 be dumped into。

q64.sampleAnswer: To deal with the situation in which drivers fall asleep halfway in traffic jams during peak travel hours, drone wake-up call services have been introduced.
references: To deal with the situation in which drivers fall asleep halfway in traffic jams during peak travel hours, drone wake-up call services have been introduced.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “针对……问题”可用 to deal with the situation；in which 引导定语从句；“已推出”用现在完成时被动 have been introduced。

q65.sampleAnswer: The cost of his children’s education is a great drain on his money.
references: The cost of his children’s education is a great drain on his money.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “花了他很多钱”就是“对他的钱是巨大的消耗”：be a great drain on one’s money。

q66.sampleAnswer: Art is not as important as life, but the life without art is dull.
references: Art is not as important as life, but the life without art is dull.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “没有……重要”用 not as important as；dull“乏味的”作表语。

q67.sampleAnswer: It is the regrets over yesterday and the fear of tomorrow that drive men mad!
references: It is the regrets over yesterday and the fear of tomorrow that drive men mad!

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “真正……的是”用强调句 It is ... that ...；drive sb. mad“把某人逼疯”。

q68.sampleAnswer: It is required by the school that students should be dressed in school uniforms every day.
references: It is required by the school that students should be dressed in school uniforms every day.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “学校规定”= It is required by the school that ...，从句用 should + 动词原形；be dressed in“穿着”。

q69.sampleAnswer: The price of this shirt has dropped by 100 yuan compared to last week, making it a very cost-effective purchase now.
references: The price of this shirt has dropped by 100 yuan compared to last week, making it a very cost-effective purchase now.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q69.explanationZh: “降了 100 元”= has dropped by 100 yuan，by 表示差额；making ... 是现在分词作结果状语。

q70.sampleAnswer: Whatever difficulty you might meet with, all your dreams will come true as long as you keep on working hard.
references: Whatever difficulty you might meet with, all your dreams will come true as long as you keep on working hard.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q70.explanationZh: “无论什么困难”= whatever difficulty；“梦想实现”= dreams come true；“只要”= as long as。

q71.sampleAnswer: During the summer vacation, he took part in all kinds of volunteer activities to raise money for the survivors of the earthquake, which benefited him a lot.
references: During the summer vacation, he took part in all kinds of volunteer activities to raise money for the survivors of the earthquake, which benefited him a lot.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q71.explanationZh: during“在……期间”；take part in“参加”；which 引导非限制性定语从句指代前面整件事。
